channel.description: Synthetic demo feed generated for offline use. Not real news.

item.title: Open-source language model tops reasoning benchmark
item.description: A research group released an open-source language model that scored highly on a public reasoning benchmark. The model was trained with a mixture of synthetic and curated data. Researchers said evaluation on more diverse tasks is still needed. The weights are available under a permissive licence.

item.title: Chipmaker unveils energy-efficient AI accelerator
item.description: A semiconductor company announced an accelerator designed for running machine learning inference at low power. The company claims improved performance per watt compared with its previous generation. Independent benchmarks have not yet been published. Shipments are planned for next year.

item.title: Universities expand machine learning curriculum
item.description: Several engineering colleges are adding courses on machine learning operations and responsible AI. Faculty said students need practical experience deploying models. The new courses include projects on data pipelines and model monitoring. Industry partners will provide guest lectures.

item.title: Cybersecurity agencies warn about phishing using deepfake audio
item.description: Security agencies issued guidance about phishing calls that use synthetic voices. Attackers imitate executives to request urgent payments. The guidance recommends verification through a second channel. Organisations are advised to train staff to recognise such requests.

item.title: New framework simplifies deploying Python web services
item.description: Developers released a framework update that reduces boilerplate when deploying Python web APIs in containers. The update adds built-in health checks and configuration through environment variables. Early users reported shorter setup times. Documentation includes Docker examples.
